original: sati khede viśramya sarvam idaṃ kuśalam anuttarāyai samyaksaṃbodhaye 'bhimataphalasiddhaye ca pariṇamayya pūrvavat pūjāṃ kṛtvā svahṛdbījākṣare maṇḍalam antarbhāvya tata utthāya svadevatātmakam ātmānam adhimucya sarvaṃ kurvīta |
analyzed: sati khede viśramya sarvam idam kuśalam anuttarāyai samyaksaṃbodhaye bhimata phala siddhaye ca pariṇamayya pūrvavat pūjām kṛtvā sva hṛd bīja akṣare maṇḍalam antarbhāvya tatas utthāya sva devatā ātmakam ātmānam adhimucya sarvam kurvīta

original: sarvaṃ ca bhojyaṃ pañcabhir bījaiḥ pañcajñānāmṛtamayaṃ kṛtvā svahṛdaye ca devatācakram adhimucya vicintya ca tajjihvāsu tad amṛtaṃ juhūyāt | snānaṃ kurvan devatābhiṣekavidhiṃ dhyāyāt |
analyzed: sarvam ca bhojyam pañcabhiḥ bījaiḥ pañca jñāna amṛta mayam kṛtvā sva hṛdaye ca devatā cakram adhimucya vicintya ca tad jihvāsu tat amṛtam juhūyāt snānam kurvan devatā abhiṣeka vidhim dhyāyāt

original: madhyāhnasāyāhnasandhyayos tu maṇḍalagṛhaṃ praviśya svahṛdbījaraśmibhir ādhāramaṇḍalaṃ nirmāya tata eva bījāc catasro yoginīḥ krameṇa saṃsphārya yathāsthānaṃ niveśya pūrvavad abhiṣekādikaṃ sarvaṃ vidhim anuṣṭhāya maṇḍalam antarbhāvya, tata utthāya pūrvavat samāhitayogaṃ kuryāt |
analyzed: madhyāhna sāyāhna sandhyayoḥ tu maṇḍala gṛham praviśya sva hṛd bīja raśmibhiḥ ādhāra maṇḍalam nirmāya tatas eva bījāt catasraḥ yoginīḥ krameṇa saṃsphārya yathāsthānam niveśya pūrvavat abhiṣeka ādikam sarvam vidhim anuṣṭhāya maṇḍalam antarbhāvya tatas utthāya pūrvavat samāhita yogam kuryāt

original: ardharātrasandhyāyāṃ tv ayaṃ viśeṣaḥ | saṃpūjyārghaṃ dattvā oṃ vajra mur iti jñānamaṇḍalam utsṛjya, svajñānabīje samayamaṇḍalam antarbhāvya nirābhāsaṃ saṃbodhicittam adhimucya supyāt |
analyzed: ardharātra sandhyāyām tu ayam viśeṣaḥ saṃpūjya argham dattvā om vajra mus iti jñāna maṇḍalam utsṛjya sva jñāna bīje samaya maṇḍalam antarbhāvya nirābhāsam saṃbodhi cittam adhimucya supyāt

original: evaṃ dināntareṣv api devīsaṃgīticodanotthāpitaḥ sarvaṃ pūrvavat kuryāt | evaṃ pratyahaṃ yāvat siddhinimittāni labhate |
analyzed: evam dina antareṣu api devī saṃgīti codana utthāpitaḥ sarvam pūrvavat kuryāt evam pratyaham yāvat siddhi nimittāni labhate

original: tatra maṇḍaleśvarasya mantro lakṣajāpena sidhyati, śeṣāṇām ayutajāpena |
analyzed: tatra maṇḍaleśvarasya mantraḥ lakṣa jāpena sidhyati śeṣāṇām ayuta jāpena

original: mālāmantrāś ca tantrāntarād ānetavyāḥ | tān svahṛtsūrye hṛccandre vā yathāyogaṃ maṇḍalīkṛtya pradīpamālāvaj jvalataś cetasābhilikhya manasā vācayann iva japed iti ||
analyzed: mālāmantrāḥ ca tantra antarāt ānetavyāḥ tān sva hṛd sūrye hṛd candre vā yathāyogam maṇḍalīkṛtya pradīpa mālā vat jvalataḥ cetasā abhilikhya manasā vācayan iva japet iti
bruvatā evam mahāmāyā sādhanam yat mayā arjitam

original: kuśalaṃ tena buddhaḥ syāṃ vaśī viśvārthasādhane ||
analyzed: kuśalam tena buddhaḥ syām vaśī viśva artha sādhane
mahāmāyā sādhanam samāptam
